facts.fact: NaCSA and Statistics Sierra Leone signed an amended MoU on 8 April 2026 (reported in a page published 8 May 2026) on data collaboration for the PSSNYE project, to expand the SPRINT social protection registry to national coverage and support targeting, monitoring and impact evaluation; no statistics from the registry are stated as published.
